summary: A compact one-page specimen for Norse Sans: a wall of OpenType-feature sentences whose weight is set by one slider, split-wordmark intro cards, five weight tiles with random glyphs and a hover-expanding character grid. Everything sits on a lilac-white page with hairline boxes and clipped corner ticks; the only buy path is a fixed Gumroad pill.

instances.look: Nine full-bleed lines of repeating text at 60px, each demonstrating one OpenType feature (small caps → SS QQ GG, ligatures, fractions, slashed zero, arrow ligatures, oldstyle figures, stylistic alternates), cropped by both edges, above a small dotted weight slider with a 'REGULAR' label
instances.feel: A datasheet turned into a wall of type
instances.ux: The lines fade in one by one and drift sideways; dragging the single slider handle steps the whole wall through the weights, and the label above the handle names the current one
instances.learn: Make the hero sentence wall a feature inventory, each line repeating one feature, so one weight slider tests every feature at once

reconstruction.layout: Starts at y=128 below a 77px fixed bar. Nine lines, ~90px line pitch (960px total), full-bleed with overflow hidden and each line offset so words crop at both edges; below it a centred slider ~1140px wide with seven pips, label above the handle
reconstruction.typography: Lines: 60px Norse Regular, tight sentence case, #111. Weight label: ~11px Norse Bold uppercase, tracked. Feature spans via classes .smcp .dlig .onum .zero .tnum .ss01–.ss04
reconstruction.behaviour: Lines reveal staggered on load (t≈1.6–2.2s) with slow horizontal drift. noUiSlider with one handle (0–5 range, value shown as 2.50) and seven pips sets the font weight of all lines; label text updates (Regular, Bold…). Handle is a tall thin box with two grips
reconstruction.content: Each line repeats one phrase: 'Norse Sans', 'Impressive language support — Château ∞ d'Eau. Małżeńska* "tükörfúrógép"', 'Small caps → SS QQ GG HH JJ', 'Lovely ligatures rf rt fi', 'Fantastic fractions 180° m² Roughly ½ on 19/07/2011', 'Slashed zeroes 00/00', 'Arrow ligatures → = →', 'Oldstyle figures 1246 → 1246', 'Stylistic Alternates [ ɑ/a, l/I, B/B, A/A ]'

instances.look: The name split into two: bold 'NOR' beside a hairline card of copy, then a card of copy beside bold 'SE', staggered left and right so the eye zig-zags
instances.feel: Airy and diagrammatic, like a labelled drawing
instances.learn: Split the wordmark across two rows and use the fragments as anchors for two short copy cards, so the about text reads as part of the logo

reconstruction.layout: Two rows, each 80% of the 1140px container, the first aligned right and the second left. Each row is 40% wordmark fragment and 60% bordered card (~370×150px), with a dashed rule along the top running from the fragment. Cards have a clipped diagonal tick at top-left and bottom-right corners
reconstruction.typography: Fragments 96px Norse Bold (fw9), uppercase; cards 16px then 14px Regular, leading ~1.4, #111
reconstruction.content: 'A typeface for the modern world. An exciting combo between grotesque principles and legibility.' and 'Norse really shines when small…sports enough pizzazz to be used in titles and print design.'
reconstruction.html: .furniture draws the corner ticks on a .ba bordered box; .bt-dashed for the rule

instances.look: '5 Weights': three-column staggered grid of square hairline tiles, each with the style name on a dashed rule and one glyph or pair in that weight. The fixed bar covers the tops of the first row in the stitched crop
instances.ux: Each load picks a different glyph per tile (↖, 7, Hh on one capture; 06, €, 2 on another)
instances.learn: Randomise the sample glyph per tile on load, so a tiny overview shows more of the character set over repeat visits

reconstruction.layout: Three columns of ~30% width; each has a label and a dashed top rule, and a 260px square tile in the right 60%. Second row has two tiles, the first and third columns, leaving the middle empty
reconstruction.typography: Labels 16px Regular; tile glyph ~48px (f1) at fw9, fw5, fw4 and lighter
reconstruction.behaviour: span.random gets a random glyph on load; tiles fade up on scroll
reconstruction.content: Bold, DemiBold, Regular, Light, Thin with one random glyph or pair each

instances.look: Four ruled sections (Characters, Numerals, Punctuation, Symbols), each with a label and small note at left and a 10-column grid of 100px bordered cells at right; letter cells show a case pair. Sticky bar repeats through the stitched crop
instances.ux: Hovering a cell inverts it to black; letter cells hold a hidden list of accented variants that expand on hover (Ā, Ç, Ď, Ę in the capture)
instances.learn: Put accents inside the base letter's cell and reveal them on hover: 29 cells stand in for ~120 glyphs and the grid stays short

reconstruction.layout: Left column 30% label (~340px) with dashed rule on top; right 70% grid of 100×100px cells, 10 per row, 1px #111 borders collapsed. Sections ~270–400px tall with ~80px gaps
reconstruction.typography: Cell glyphs ~24–30px (f4/f3) Regular; labels 16px; note 14px grey
reconstruction.behaviour: CSS hover-bg-black hover-white on each cell; .expand-list cells swap to the next of up to four accented li items while hovered (others .dn)
reconstruction.content: Whole Latin set by category; note 'Supports — Portuguese, Italian, Moldovan, Spanish, French, Turkish, Romanian, Polish, Swedish and many more'

instances.look: Never cut as a block: one 16px line 'Made by graz.io' at the end of block 01
instances.learn: A one-line credit is enough when the bar above always carries the buy link

reconstruction.layout: Left-aligned line ~50px below the last grid

instances.look: Fixed 77px bar on page tint with a bottom hairline: 'Norse Sans Typeface' left, outlined 'Purchase Norse →' pill right (Gumroad link), the only buy route on the page
